Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, late 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight silver wrapping-paper micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully covering her, neatly folded with clean edges and no tears, paired with a strapless silver wrapping-paper bandeau with a fine metallic pattern, neatly cut with clean edges and no tears, reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and tied with a small blue ribbon bow at the center front, fully opaque and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, no other garment on her chest, her stomach fully visible below it. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a sunny summer garden in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: a gigantic yellow sunflower with petals as long as her whole body fills the frame, a giant fuzzy bee hovering beside it, giant green leaves with veins like roads, a softly blurred garden of flowers far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall sitting on a giant sunflower petal with the giant flowers rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright warm sunlight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous sunflower, bee and leaves around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor.
